_comment: Upwork-independence CLIENT-ACQUISITION portfolio = the ONLY agent-writable surface during an optimize run. channel_effort values are DECISIONS: each is the fraction of the fixed acquisition-HOURS budget directed to that OWNED channel (sum <= 1; the rest reinvests at the opportunity rate). The reality that turns effort into won clients (per-channel cost/pool/ramp/value, the hours+cash budgets, the delivery serviceable-cap) is LOCKED in tools/scorers/leadgen-portfolio.py. Upwork is the status-quo being replaced, not a channel here. Edit values, not structure. Bounds + geo-legality enforced by tools/leadgen-portfolio-validate.py. Baseline is a naive even hedge across all five owned channels; the loop climbs from here.
